page.layout: One block: the front board of a limp-or-boarded binding with blind-stamped decoration and two metal clasps on the fore-edge. No printed text blocks.
page.notes: Photograph of the front cover of the binding, not a printed page. Blind-stamped panels and borders with floral and foliate rolls, a central rectangular panel, and four raised bands on the spine edge. Two brass clasps with pointed terminals on the right (fore-edge) side, one with a green enamel or stone inset. Brown ink or water stains at the top and in the upper centre. No legible printed words, title, or label are visible on the cover, so none are transcribed.
